modules.description: Module path under the host (e.g. "foo", "tools/bar") to repository. Prefixes match whole path segments, longest first.

browser.description: What a browser on a module path gets. go-get=1 requests always get the meta tags.

title.description: Index page heading. Defaults to the host.

index_redirect.description: If set, / redirects here instead of serving the index.

host.description: Module host, when it differs from the request's Host.

repoURL.description: Repository URL. A trailing slash and .git are stripped.

branch.description: Branch used in the go-source link templates.

description.description: Shown on the index and module pages.

source.description: go-source template style. Inferred for github.com, gitlab.com and codeberg.org; otherwise no go-source tag unless set. "none" suppresses it.
